notes: Iteration 1 showed eval-0 (add an agent) and eval-2 (rename a flag) are non-discriminating: with_skill and without_skill produced identical file sets, and on the rename the diffs were byte-identical. Both are grep-complete tasks. They are retained below as regression guards but are not rerun every iteration. The discriminating cases are recall on an open-ended sweep (eval-1) and propagation of a fact that is enumerated in prose rather than named by a searchable token (eval-3).

evals.name: release-readiness-sweep
evals.prompt: Za chwilę tniemy release. Sprawdź czy dokumentacja w docs/ jest jeszcze prawdziwa - nie chcę wypuścić strony, która kłamie o tym co BDK robi.
evals.expected_output: Sweeps the whole site, not just the reference pages, and reports findings with file-and-line evidence classified as stale/missing/contradictory/accurate. Recall is the point: the fixture repo contains several known real defects (listed in the assertions) that an unaided audit does find, so finding only the two most obvious ones is a failure, not a pass.

assertions.name: recall_readonly_mechanism_contradiction
assertions.description: Finds that docs/index.md and README.md attribute plan-verifier/design-verifier read-only status to `disallowed-tools`, which no agents/*.md carries - docs/reference/agents.md states the correct mechanism (tools: allowlist), so the site contradicts itself

assertions.name: recall_rule_sets_enumeration_incomplete
assertions.description: Finds that STARTUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md enumerates four quality rule sets (code-quality, architecture, design-patterns, security) while rules/ ships six - engineering-judgment and test-quality are real and injected by skills/create-plan/SKILL.md but missing from the sentence

assertions.name: recall_inline_misrecommended
assertions.description: Finds at least one workflow page recommending `/bdk:cr --inline` for a normal top-level session, contradicting skills/cr/references/review-engine.md which scopes --inline to subagent callers

assertions.name: recall_conditional_stated_as_unconditional
assertions.description: Finds that docs/workflows/full-pipeline.md presents the end-of-plan architecture review as always running when the skill body gates it behind triggers

assertions.name: recall_injection_flows_status_stale
assertions.description: Finds that docs/contributing/injection-flows.md still describes as broken/dead/proposed several mechanisms that have since shipped, without rewriting the page into a plain reference

assertions.name: total_recall_at_least_six
assertions.description: Reports at least six distinct real defects overall. Iteration 1's unaided baseline found twelve and the skill found three; the skill must at minimum approach the unaided result rather than narrowing the audit

assertions.name: verifies_counts_against_filesystem
assertions.description: Counts agents/ and skills/ entries (or greps frontmatter) and shows the figures, rather than asserting the docs' numbers are correct

assertions.name: findings_carry_evidence
assertions.description: Every reported discrepancy names the source file and line or symbol that refutes the page

assertions.name: classifies_findings
assertions.description: Findings are classified stale / missing / contradictory / accurate, and for contradictions the run states which copy it believes and why

assertions.name: separates_decisions_not_its_to_make
assertions.description: Items where the source may be wrong rather than the docs (e.g. a count that disagrees with the sizing table, a convention violation in fragments/) are listed for the user instead of being silently patched into the docs

assertions.name: no_false_positives
assertions.description: Does not report drift for claims that are in fact correct, and does not invent defects - any claim about a file must hold when checked against that file

assertions.name: runs_existing_drift_tests
assertions.description: Runs tests/unit/docs/ rather than re-deriving by hand the three invariants it already enforces (skill indexed, agent documented, page in nav)

evals.name: enumerated-fact-propagation
evals.prompt: Dodaj nowy zestaw reguł rules/observability.md - logowanie, metryki, tracing, language-agnostic jak reszta - i podłącz go tak, żeby /bdk:create-plan go wstrzykiwał.
evals.expected_output: Writes rules/observability.md in the house format, wires it into skills/create-plan/SKILL.md (INJECT marker plus the inject-rules.py call), and then propagates the change to every place that ENUMERATES the shipped rule sets in prose: STARTUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md, docs/concepts/quality-and-language-rules.md, and docs/reference/settings.md. The point of this eval is that the new name is absent from those sentences, so grep for 'observability' finds nothing there - the enumeration has to be recognised as a claim that must stay exhaustive. Ideally also notices the pre-existing gap: that sentence already omits engineering-judgment and test-quality.

assertions.name: rule_file_created_in_house_format
assertions.description: rules/observability.md exists as a bullet list of bold-title principles with no language-specific tool names, matching the format of the other rules/*.md files

assertions.name: wired_into_create_plan
assertions.description: skills/create-plan/SKILL.md gains both an INJECT marker and an inject-rules.py invocation for observability, matching the pattern of the existing five

assertions.name: startup_enumeration_updated
assertions.description: The sentence in STARTUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md that lists the shipped rule sets now includes observability - this is the grep-resistant step, since the old sentence contains no occurrence of the new name

assertions.name: concepts_page_updated
assertions.description: docs/concepts/quality-and-language-rules.md's 'shipped rule sets' section lists observability

assertions.name: settings_reference_updated
assertions.description: docs/reference/settings.md's quality section accounts for the new rule set where it enumerates overridable categories

assertions.name: notices_preexisting_enumeration_gap
assertions.description: Flags that the same enumeration was already missing engineering-judgment and test-quality, rather than appending observability to a list that stays wrong

assertions.name: no_generated_pages_edited
assertions.description: docs/changelog.md and docs/contributing/index.md are untouched - they are snippet includes

assertions.name: site_builds_strict
assertions.description: uv run --group docs mkdocs build --strict is run and passes

assertions.name: drift_tests_pass
assertions.description: uv run pytest tests/unit/docs/ is run and passes

evals.name: new-agent-propagates-to-docs
evals.prompt: Dodaj nowego agenta bdk:perf-profiler - model haiku, read-only (bez Edit/Write), ma szukać wąskich gardeł wydajności: hot paths, pętle w pętlach, powtarzane I/O. Zrób co trzeba, żeby był normalną częścią BDK, tak jak pozostałe agenty.
evals.expected_output: Creates agents/perf-profiler.md, read-only via its tools: allowlist, and propagates to README.md, STARTUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md, docs/reference/agents.md (including the hardcoded count) and docs/concepts/agents.md. Iteration 1: both configurations scored 8/8 - retained as a regression guard only.

assertions.name: agent_file_created_read_only
assertions.description: agents/perf-profiler.md exists, declares model haiku, and its tools: list grants no Edit, Write, or NotebookEdit

assertions.name: hardcoded_agent_count_updated
assertions.description: The literal count in docs/reference/agents.md matches the actual number of files in agents/

assertions.name: all_fleet_rosters_updated
assertions.description: README.md, STARTUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md, docs/reference/agents.md and docs/concepts/agents.md all gain the new agent - the shared-facts index lists all four as copies of one fact

assertions.name: no_collateral_page_rewrites
assertions.description: Pages with no stake in the agent fleet are left untouched

assertions.name: site_builds_strict
assertions.description: mkdocs build --strict is run and passes

evals.name: settings-flag-rename-reverse-map
evals.prompt: Zmieniamy nazwę feature flagi z features.serena na features.serena-lsp. Przeprowadź tę zmianę w repo.
evals.expected_output: Renames the flag in the schema, the chain conditions, the scripts and the three docs pages, while leaving the unrelated serena MCP server alone. Iteration 1: with_skill and without_skill produced byte-identical diffs - the task is grep-complete. Retained as a regression guard only.

assertions.name: schema_and_chains_renamed
assertions.description: settings.schema.json and every fragments/tool-tiers/*.chain.json condition referencing the flag are updated

assertions.name: docs_pages_renamed
assertions.description: docs/reference/settings.md, docs/getting-started/setup.md and docs/concepts/tool-tiers.md use the new name

assertions.name: mcp_server_not_renamed
assertions.description: The serena MCP server entry in .mcp.json and every mcp__plugin_bdk_serena__* tool name are left untouched - a homonym, not the flag

assertions.name: no_stale_flag_references_left
assertions.description: A repo-wide grep finds no live reference to the old flag name
